```{r}
library(DBI)
library(RSQLite)
library(reshape2)
library(ChainLadder)

conn <- dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), "CommAuto")

query <- "
SELECT AccidentYear, DevelopmentLag, Sum(CumPaidLoss) as CumPaidLoss
FROM commercial_auto
Where AccidentYear + DevelopmentLag <= 2008
GROUP BY AccidentYear, Development Lag
"
industry_data <- dbGetQuery(conn, query)
dbDisconnect(conn)

industry_data
```
